name: Linker Bell Academia ~Ryuuzoku no Fiancée~
original_name: リンカーベル・アカデミア ～龍族のフィアンセ～
source:
When Misaki Hiro steps into a convenience store to buy a late-night snack, he finds himself transported to another world.

"You have been chosen—as the hero who will save this world."

Summoned as the familiar of Eros Strobel, Hiro enrolls at Animato Girls' Academy, a school specializing in magic.

--Eros Strobel, a witch from a prestigious family who can't use magic.
--Melly, a laid-back, easygoing dragon mage with no sense of urgency.
--Hibiki Flamel, a kemonomimi alchemist who's always holed up in her lab.

Surrounded by girls, Hiro's new life is filled with lucky perverted moments and unavoidable awkward situations.

In the world of bells and magic, Partition, Hiro's new adventure begins.

<The Dragon's Fiancé>

As Hiro prepares for the next adventure exam, he teams up with Melly as his partner.

Melly is emotionally reserved, making it hard to tell what she's thinking. On top of that, she has zero wariness around the opposite sex. Hiro's days are filled with flustered reactions to her bold behavior.

One night, after finishing their training, Hiro stumbles upon Melly bathing in a spring behind the academy.

Her naked body glows under the moonlight. Noticing Hiro, Melly remains expressionless as she says:

"—I've found my future spouse."

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ014724.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
当美咲宏走进一家便利店购买夜宵时，他发现自己穿越到了另一个世界。

“你被选为拯救这个世界的英雄。”

浩作为爱洛斯·史特罗贝尔的使魔被召唤，就读于阿尼马托女子学院，这是一所专门研究魔法的学校。

——爱洛斯·史特罗贝尔，出身名门望族的女巫，不会使用魔法。
——梅莉，一个悠闲、随和、没有紧迫感的龙魔法师。
——响·勒梅，一位总是躲在实验室里的兽类炼金术士。

在女孩的包围下，宏的新生活充满了幸运的变态时刻和不可避免的尴尬局面。

在钟声与魔法的世界“分区”中，小宏的新冒险开始了。

<龙的未婚夫>

当宏准备下一次冒险考试时，他与梅莉作为搭档组队。

梅莉在情感上很保守，让人很难说出她在想什么。最重要的是，她对异性的戒心为零。阿宏的日子里充满了对她大胆行为的慌乱反应。

一天晚上，完成训练后，宏偶然发现梅莉正在学院后面的泉水里洗澡。

她赤裸的身体在月光下闪闪发光。看到宏，梅莉面无表情地说道：

“——我已经找到了未来的配偶了。”
